newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CP CZK 85.2 MLN 9MO PRE-TAX PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CP CZK 85.2 MLN 9MO PRE-TAX PROFIT.

text.p: Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna a.s.(CP) posted an 85 million crown pre-tax profit for the first nine months of the year, the firm said in a statement on Monday.
Comparative figures for the period were not immediately available, but the firm posted a 413 million crown net profit for 1995.
The figures were calculated according to Czech accounting standards.
Ceska Pojistovna said insurance premiums for the January-September period totalled some 21 billion crowns, an increase of 12.3 percent over the same time frame last year.
"The January-September figure accounts for 81.6 percent of our planned 1996 total," it said.
Reserves for life insurance rose by 900 million crowns to 53.1 billion, while reserves for other categories of insurance grew by 3.28 billion crowns to 12.3 billion.
CP is the largest Czech insurer with between 70 and 80 percent of the domestic market.
